# Context menu

A menu of actions on right-click or long-press.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Accessible first</span> Context menus are for power users. Here nobody remembers the interface, and every action looks like a button people can find. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./button">Button</a></span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-context-menu--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:accessible-first;mode:light" title="Context menu examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-context-menu--docs">Open Context menu in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-context-menu--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:accessible-first;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Power users acting on an item in place, with the same actions also reachable elsewhere.
- **Not when:** The only way to reach an action: people who don't know to right-click never find it.

Instead:

- [Dropdown menu](./dropdown-menu.md): The same actions from a visible button.

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Shift F10 or the menu key opens it; arrows move; Escape closes. | undefined |



## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add context-menu
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Context menu reads 72 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Context menu's tokens to change Context menu alone.
